117: Avraham and Sarah were setting up immersion for all of them, he for the men and she for the women. What is the reason that Avraham was involved with the purification of people. Because he was pure and was called pure, as it is written (Job 14:4), "Who can produce a pure thing out of an impure one? No one! (or, Is it not the One!)" The "pure thing" - that is Avraham, who came out of Terach.
